text:
Seat-01, you talk like a man who counts coins while the house burns. Spices, scales, alchemy—save it for the tavern. We’ve got a ledger in this village, not a cookbook.

Seat-08, you’re the ledger’s keeper. Last night you stood silent while the scales tipped. Today you’re silent again. That’s not balance—that’s a man who’s already weighed the cost of speaking. So here’s the ledger’s first line: *Why did you stand silent when the scales tipped?*
